paper.title: Weight regain and cardiometabolic effects after withdrawal of semaglutide: The STEP 1 trial extension
paper.short: Wilding et al., Diabetes Obes Metab 2022

message: Weight coming back after stopping is biology, not failure, so a good programme plans the 'after' from day one.
reasoning: 'Will I gain it all back?' is the most emotional doubt in the brief and the one competitors dodge. We state the trial number plainly, say what the data cannot tell you, then turn the fear into a question you can ask a doctor. That matches Steer's 'a planned exit' promise.

claims.quote: participants regained two-thirds of their prior weight loss
mean weight loss was 17.3% (SD: 9.3%) with semaglutide
Cardiometabolic improvements seen from week 0 to week 68 with semaglutide reverted towards baseline at week 120 for most variables.
Findings confirm the chronicity of obesity
An off-treatment extension assessed for a further year a representative subset of participants who had completed 68 weeks of treatment.

lines: Health markers also drifted back toward where they started.

slides.headline: What this *can't* tell you.
slides.body: These are averages from a follow-up of 327 adults, a subset of the original trial. It is a signal, not a promise about your body.

slides.headline: So ask a better *question.*
lines: Not 'will I fail?' but *'what is my plan for after?'*
Habits, food, strength and check-ins, planned from day one.

slides.small: No obligation. If it isn't right for you, they'll say so.

carousel.caption:
The worry nobody says out loud: will it all come back?

In a trial follow-up of 327 adults, people who stopped both the medicine and the lifestyle support had regained about two-thirds of the weight they lost a year later. Averages, not a promise about you.

That is biology, not a failure of willpower. It is why we plan the 'after' from day one: habits, food, strength and check-ins.

Before you start, hear it from a doctor, not a reel. steerclub.com

Source: Wilding et al., Diabetes Obes Metab 2022 (STEP 1 trial extension).
carousel.caption_hi:
Sabse bada darr: kya sab wapas aa jayega?

Ek trial follow-up mein 327 adults the. Jinhone medicine aur lifestyle support dono band kiye, unka ek saal baad lagbhag do-tihai ghataya hua weight wapas aa gaya tha. Yeh averages hain, aapke liye promise nahi.

Yeh biology hai, willpower ki kami nahi. Isiliye hum 'baad ka plan' pehle din se banate hain: habits, khana, strength aur check-ins.

Shuru karne se pehle doctor se suniye, reel se nahi. steerclub.com

Source: Wilding et al., Diabetes Obes Metab 2022.
